sections.heading: CLEAR MAX LASIK: Precision Vision, Powered by All-Laser Technology

items.v:
CLEAR MAX LASIK is Optimax’s premium all-laser vision correction treatment, designed for patients seeking precise, safe, and comfortable visual outcomes. Using advanced ZIEMER’s Swiss-made femtosecond laserr technology, CLEAR MAX corrects refractive errors with exceptional accuracy — without the use of blades.
At Optimax Eye Specialist Malaysia, CLEAR MAX LASIK combines world-class technology with personalised surgical care to help patients achieve clearer vision and faster recovery.

CLEAR MAX LASIK is a 100% laser-based LASIK procedure that uses femtosecond laser to reshape the cornea and improve how light focuses on the retina.
Unlike traditional LASIK, CLEAR MAX is a flapless keyhole vision correction procedure that corrects vision based on your individual eye profile.
This advanced laser approach enhances accuracy, comfort, and overall treatment safety.
*Suitability is determined by a comprehensive eye assessment with our specialists.

yes.heading: Who Can Benefit from CLEAR MAX LASIK?

items.v: You may be suitable for CLEAR MAX LASIK if you:

v: Are 18 years and above with a stable prescription
Prefer a precise, all-laser LASIK option
Want a faster recovery with minimal discomfort

items.v: A comprehensive eye assessment at Optimax is required to confirm suitability.

no.heading: Who Is Not Suitable for CLEAR MAX LASIK?

items.v: CLEAR MAX LASIK may not be suitable for individuals who:

v: Have unstable vision or underlying eye conditions

items.v: Our ophthalmologists will advise on the safest alternative treatment if CLEAR MAX is not recommended.

sections.heading: CLEAR MAX LASIK Procedure Steps

items.title: Eye Mapping
items.text: Detailed scans of your eyes are used to personalise treatment.

items.title: Lenticule Creation
items.text: A small disc-shaped piece of corneal tissue (lenticule) and a small incision are created within the cornea.

items.title: Lenticule Removal
items.text: The lenticule is removed through the incision with minimal stress to the cornea.

items.title: Healing & Recovery
items.text: The cornea is reshaped, correcting the refractive error and allowing vision to improve within days.

note: The laser portion typically takes 30–45 seconds per eye.

sections.heading: Pre & Post CLEAR MAX LASIK Instruction

groups.label: Before Your Procedure:
items: Stop wearing contact lenses as advised
Avoid makeup, perfume, or skincare on treatment day
Arrange transport home after the procedure

groups.label: After Your Procedure:
items: Use prescribed eye drops as directed
Avoid rubbing your eyes, swimming, or strenuous activity for one month

note: Many patients achieve clear vision within a few days.
